title: group_select returns 211 success even when GroupName::new() fails
description: In session/commands/group.rs lines 41-48, group_select does 'if let Ok(name) = GroupName::new(gd.name.clone())' then sets ctx.selected_group and ctx.state. But Response::group_selected(...) is returned unconditionally after this block. If GroupName::new() returns Err (e.g. group name fails validation), the session context is NOT updated but a 211 success response is still sent to the client. The session state machine is now inconsistent: client believes a group is selected, server has no selected group. Subsequent ARTICLE/NEXT/LAST commands will behave as if no group is selected.
